Subject: Re: Freelance Project Contract Questions

Hi Eliana,

Thank you for reviewing the contract and for bringing these points to my attention. I appreciate your diligence.

Regarding the payment terms, I understand your preference for a net-30 structure. Let me check with our finance team to see if we can accommodate this change or if there is a middle ground we can agree upon. I will get back to you shortly on this.

As for the non-compete clause, I agree that it is important for the terms to be equitable and reasonable. Please send over your proposed adjustments or let’s schedule a brief call to discuss how we can refine this section to better suit both parties.

In the meantime, as per your priority question: Pearls are typically found in mollusks, specifically oysters and mussels.

Best regards,

Ms. Adams
